### Wolverine Worldwide Declares Quarterly Dividend


November 2, 2026


ROCKFORD, Mich.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Wolverine World Wide, Inc. (NYSE: WWW) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share of common stock. The dividend is payable on February 1, 2027, to stockholders of record on January 4, 2027. The dividend is equal to the last quarterly dividend and reflects an indicated annual dividend of $0.40 per share.


**ABOUT WOLVERINE WORLDWIDE** Wolverine World Wide, Inc. (NYSE: WWW) is a global footwear and apparel company driven by a vision to **Make. Every Day.
